Good to know

Questions, answered

How fast is a prescription refill?
Most refills are ready within 15 minutes during opening hours. Send the request from this page or by phone and we will text you when it is packed.
Is home delivery really free?
Yes — delivery is free on all orders of $35 or more within 5 miles. Smaller orders carry a flat $4.99 delivery fee. Same-day delivery for orders placed before 4 pm.
Do I need an appointment for a flu shot or health check?
No appointment is needed. Walk in any day and a pharmacist will see you in our private consultation corner, usually within a few minutes.
Which payment methods do you accept?
Cash and all major cards in store; card payment on delivery. Prices on this page are in US dollars and include any listed discounts.
Can you help if my prescription has run out?
Yes. With your permission we contact your doctor's office for a renewal and let you know as soon as it is approved — no extra charge.
